**BOOK III — THE RUNNING DARK · Chapter 8 — No Bells · the first full day up the stream, the night, and the next morning**

- **Where:** The Thornwild; a camp in the lee of the stream bank, within sight of a lit lamp-post, a day up the frozen stream.
- **The quest:** *Over the River.* Over the frozen Wend and in under the trees of the Thornwild, the clans' country, with what the stones say and the grey cloaks' smoke behind him on the causeway. He wants a roof among people who have every reason to refuse him one, and the truth of the ford from the far side of it.
- **What Darrow is fighting right now:** A watch he cannot see, and a door he has wronged without knowing it.
- **Just happened (Scene):** *Bread on a Stump.* In the morning the loaf on the stump was gone, and the red cloth with it; in the snow beside the stump there was one ski-track, coming and going.
- **With him:** Maelis Vorne (At the camp by the lit lamp.) · Ser Hollis Garrow (At the camp by the lit lamp.) · Wren Ashdown (At the camp by the lit lamp with the ledger.) · Rae Thorne (At the camp by the lit lamp.) · Ash (At the camp by the lit lamp.)
- **The tales:** Tale 1 — Where Not to Stand (told in full) · Tale 2 — Road's the Road (told in full) · Tale 3 — Two Boys Holding Horses (2 of 3 told)
- **Against him:** A watch that walks beside them unseen.
- **Next:** On up the frozen stream.
- **Open choice:** none.
